newsitem.title: USA: CIG Wyo. gas compressor snag to cut volumes.
newsitem.headline: CIG Wyo. gas compressor snag to cut volumes.

text.p: Colorado Interstate Gas Co, a unit of Coastal Corp, said Monday it declared force majeure effective Tuesday due to a compressor problem at its Rawlins compressor station in south-central Wyoming.

"We lost a compressor unit at the Rawlins compressor station. We are anticipating some capacity reductions but we're not sure what the volumes will be," a company spokesman said, adding any reductions would take place Wednesday.

The spokesman said the company was targeting Friday evening to get the mainline back in service. The line flows gas from production areas in Wyoming to Colorado, where it can access pipes into Texas or the Midwest.
The spokesman said the mainline capacity was 600 million cubic feet per day.
